mapper.select:
select user, sum(duration_minutes) total_online_minutes, sum(status = 0) unCompleteCnt, mp_auth_user.username, mp_auth_user.name, tt.op_ip as ip from mp_auth_user_online_record left join mp_auth_user on mp_auth_user_online_record.user = mp_auth_user.id left join (SELECT t.op_ip, t.user_id, t.create_time, m.username FROM ( SELECT*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY create_time DESC) AS rn FROM mp_devops_log_operation WHERE op_module_id = 4) t left join mp_auth_user m on m.id = t.user_id WHERE t.rn = 1 and m.username is not null ) tt on tt.user_id = mp_auth_user_online_record.user
mp_auth_user.username is not null
AND user IN
#{userId}
and (mp_auth_user.username like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') or mp_auth_user.name like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') or tt.op_ip like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%'))
group by user order by unCompleteCnt desc,
(case when user IN
#{priorityUserId}
then 1 ELSE 2 END),
total_online_minutes desc
